build_azure_ai_route: build the Azure AI route detection for a model name returning agents, model_router, or default
create_strip_model_router_prefix: create a function that strips the model_router or model-router prefix from an Azure AI model name
get_azure_ai_config_for_model: get the appropriate Azure AI config class for a given model name based on routing rules
create_get_token_counter: create a token counter factory for Azure AI that returns AzureAIAnthropicTokenCounter for Claude models
get_azure_ai_api_base: get the Azure AI API base URL from parameter, litellm global, or AZURE_AI_API_BASE environment variable
